name: a2a-skill
description: a2a-skill — peer-to-peer agent messaging over SQLite. N agents from any CLI share a local bus. No orchestrator, no central chain of command.

install_steps: Full docs: sc skills teach a2a-skill:quickstart
install_guidance.note: Requires Python 3.9+ with sqlite3 stdlib module. The a2a wrapper auto-finds a suitable python3 on PATH. All 14 CLI commands work with zero pip dependencies. Set A2A_PROJECT env var for cross-project work.

adapterConfig.missingDependencyHelp: Install a2a: git clone https://github.com/javier-arancibia/a2a-skill.git && cd a2a-skill && ./install.sh
